chapter: Theaters, the Navy and the Singletons' partnership
title: Riding the rails to Chicago as a loner
summary: Zutty says he was a loner, going into the woods with a stick, and tells how he asked an engineer to let him shovel coal to Chicago and walked through a yard of railroad detectives.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: In all my travels I was a loner in a way. Like in (Upper Twiss?) Open woods I used to go out in the woods by myself and things like that. Just with a stick you see and nothing ever happened to me. Just like when I went to Chicago the first time I got in a flat car with all that iron on me and went out to the .........
We haven't told this you know.
No. Because we got this on the tape that got messed up. No we haven't done that yet.

The way I went up and asked the engineer, can I shovel coal to Chicago and things like that. And I walked through that yard where they had the toughest railroad detectives in the world. Walked right on through and nobody didn't say nothing. And things like that.
